metadata.title: Image-derived hazard zones ? 10 study barangays
metadata.method: Overview georeferenced from saved QGIS Map 1 extent and 300 DPI layout; close-ups aligned to overview hazard colors. Visible color pixels polygonized, clipped to existing barangay boundaries. Flood geometry retained from StudyAreaFlood_Maasin.gpkg.
metadata.limitations: Approximate image-derived zones, not original surveyed hazard vectors. Icon-covered patches are estimated from nearby visible classes and marked inferred; these are not verified hazard assessments. Other unclassified gaps remain. Original flood geometry and original visible polygons are unchanged. Orange is an outside-assessed classification, not a safety label. Publication date unverified.

icon_repair.method: Detected blue marker silhouettes plus 7 image pixels for their outlines; nearest visible same-barangay non-flood class continued only inside existing gaps under those silhouettes.
